source_text: Sors revelat Achan; confitetur: vidi pallium aureum linguam argenti. Lapidatur cum suis — peccatum unius populum laedit. Purificato castris Iesus ducit rursum ad Gai.
pass_a_gloss: Lot reveals Achan; he-confesses: I-saw cloak golden tongue of-silver. Is-stoned with his — sin of-one people harms. With-camp-purified Jesus leads again unto Ai.
pass_b_english: The lot reveals Achan; he confesses: [[I saw a cloak, silver, gold >> Bible:Joshua 7:21]]. He is stoned with his — one man’s sin wounds the people. Camp purified, Jesus leads again to Ai.
